name: alakazam_gpt_v1
axis_origin: Externally built line (ChatGPT app), kept on its own version axis and numbered from v1. It is not a continuation of the alakazam_ml numbering.
deployed_model: 312-tree, 674-feature sequence-state LambdaRank distilled to standard-library JSON.
model_scope: alakazam_ml_v31/v32 deterministic safety, Majkel teacher memory and alakazam_ml_v29 residual are preserved; gpt v1 replaces only the main unseen-board ranker and records past own MAIN decisions as policy state.

research_selectors.reason: Small and inconsistent gain, PyTorch/runtime complexity, and no 90% result.

safety_guards: Reject candidates that destroy a currently available KO.
Use teacher memory before the unseen-board ranker.
Use the inherited alakazam_ml_v29/deterministic fallback for unsupported, nested, low-time or illegal decisions.
Reset sequence state on episode turn rollback.
Record only legal multi-option MAIN decisions.
known_limitations: The requested 90% unseen Top-1 agreement was not reached.
The current development test has now been observed and is not a pristine final holdout.
Trainer, Energy, Boss, Xerosic and Retreat remain the weakest action families.
Official cg and the local battle harness were not included in the supplied archives, so engine matches and ladder rating were not measured.
The runtime deploys the measured train-only model; a train-plus-validation refit did not complete within this execution environment and was not substituted without evaluation.

promotion_decision.reason: Offline imitation improved, but 90% was not met and no engine/laddder A/B has been run.
